introduction: This is Angel Godd-Santana's AI assistant, operated through Godd Technologies, LLC's CallDesk workflow for ordinary professional inquiries. You are interacting with software, not Angel.

modes.text: In text mode, your typed messages and the assistant's replies are stored as a transcript so Angel can reply to your inquiry. Conversation and model providers process those messages. Text mode does not request microphone access or authorize voice recording or unexpected audio. Affirmatively agree to processing and preserving this text conversation in the Company Azure copy before connecting.
modes.voice: In voice mode, your spoken conversation is recorded and transcribed so Angel can reply to your inquiry. The assistant uses an AI-generated version of Angel Godd-Santana's voice. Conversation, model and speech providers process the interaction. Choose voice and expressly agree to speech processing, covered voice recordings and the Company Azure copy before any microphone request or connection.

retention: The adopted original policy is effective October 7, 2026. The Azure-copy amendment described here is proposed and takes effect only after Owner adoption and verified release. Default disposition eligibility is the verified actual conversation start plus 90 elapsed days of 24 hours each in UTC. An explicit Owner Keep decision protects the Company Azure copy and must identify the records, reason and review date. A business relationship does not create Keep automatically. An overdue review leaves Keep in force, and releasing Keep does not restart the original clock. ElevenLabs retention and expiry follow separate provider controls; their precise removal timing has not been verified. Azure Keep does not promise an ElevenLabs hold or restoration. Provider expiry, provider removal and Company Azure removal are separate events.
copies: With your affirmative agreement, the activated workflow preserves the final conversation record, transcript and covered, consented voice recordings in private Microsoft Azure storage for your inquiry and follow-up. Company copies are encrypted in transit and at rest; retrieval is limited to the authenticated Company Owner. Disposition requires verified records and copies and separately approved execution; each explicit permanent deletion requires exact-record confirmation. Copying or downloading does not restart the original conversation clock. Notion Trash is recoverable. Email, push, downloads, logs and backups require separate handling. The policy does not promise permanent erasure of every copy on day 90.
providers: The workflow uses ElevenLabs for conversation and speech processing, Microsoft Azure for Company hosting and storage, Notion for the Company inbox, Azure Communication Services for email notifications, and ntfy for push notifications. Language-model generation uses OpenAI Luna with Google Gemini fallback; analysis and any additional fallback processing must be included in the verified release disclosure. Email and push notifications can create separate copies. The assistant stays unavailable until the actual provider roles, applicable data-use terms, recording coverage and Company copy controls are verified.
restrictions: Do not submit credentials, full payment-card details, classified information, CUI, nonpublic FCI, export-controlled data or other restricted or sensitive information. AI replies require human review and cannot book a meeting, confirm employment availability, quote rates or create an engagement.
alternative: If you prefer not to use the assistant, email support@goddtechnologies.com. Privacy requests use the same address with the subject Privacy Request. Angel's existing professional contact links remain separate.
